title: Asa Defeats the Cushites in the Valley of Zephath
description: King Asa faces an overwhelming Cushite army led by Zerah at Mareshah, cries out to the Lord for help, and wins a great victory in the Valley of Zephath. The men of Judah pursue the enemy all the way to Gerar, plunder the surrounding towns, and return with vast amounts of plunder to Jerusalem.
